title: Chapter 7: The Midnight Swarm of Scavengers
chineseTitle: 第 7 章：深夜成群食腐鲨鱼围攻

paragraphs.en: Santiago knew more sharks would come. 'A man can be destroyed but not defeated,' he muttered, resolving to fight to the end. He lashed his knife to an oar, creating a crude spear. He fought off shovel-nosed sharks until his blade snapped.
paragraphs.zh: 圣地亚哥知道更多的鲨鱼会来。“一个人可以被毁灭，但不能被打败，”他自言自语，决心战斗到底。他把刀系在一根桨上做成粗糙的矛。他打退铲鼻鲨直到刀刃折断。

paragraphs.en: As night fell, a pack of scavengers arrived in the dark. Santiago fought blindly with the wooden tiller, bashing their noses until his shoulders ached with agony. But the sharks tore away the rest of the meat until nothing remained except the bare white skeleton.
paragraphs.zh: 当夜晚降临，一群食腐动物在黑暗中到达了。圣地亚哥用木制舵柄盲目地战斗，猛击它们的鼻子直到他的双肩因痛苦而发酸。但鲨鱼撕扯掉剩余的肉，直到除了裸露的白骨外什么也没剩下。
